# ledger-sync

Config lives in config.py; loader.py and app.py read it.

## Tests

Run tests only through the project runner (CI uses the same entry point; plain `python -m unittest` runs are not accepted by CI):

    python tools/run_tests.py

The runner depends on the internal `operant_testkit` package.
